description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different data sources—Tutorials, Library Documentation, StackOverflow posts, and Github files—across varying numbers of tokens, with the x-axis representing the "Number of Tokens" on a linear scale ranging from 200 to 800 in increments of 200, and the y-axis showing a numerical value ranging from 10 to 40. The blue line, representing Tutorials, starts at approximately 23 when the number of tokens is 200 and increases steadily to around 42 at 800 tokens. The red line, corresponding to Library Documentation, begins at about 27 and rises to a peak of approximately 43 at 700 tokens before slightly declining to around 42 at 800 tokens. The green line, for Github files, starts at roughly 29 and shows a consistent upward trend, reaching approximately 43 at 800 tokens. The yellow line, representing StackOverflow posts, begins at around 33 and exhibits a downward trend, decreasing to about 28 at 800 tokens. All lines are plotted with circular markers and connected by straight lines, indicating the trend of performance across the token count.
